slug: 2025-03-18 Somalia's Electoral Commission unveils digital voter registration equipment

facts.fact: Somalia's National Electoral Commission chair Abdikarim Ahmed Hassan unveiled new digital voter registration equipment in Mogadishu, to be tested at the 30 June 2025 local government elections, with public voter registration as the first phase.

note: The document says nothing about a voters' roll.

facts.fact: An opinion piece by M&E specialist Abdulrazak Abduljalil Haji says the Elections Commission uses election software to register voters and issues photo voter cards, with more than 4,000 duplicate voter records by the Commission's own account.
